title: Move the pstack source article out of the fenced docs/specs surface
action: The base tree is red: docs/specs/pstack.md trips crates/bee/tests/specs_fence.rs, which fences docs/specs as a read-only compatibility surface once a knowledge bundle exists. The article is an external source document, not this repo's area truth, so the fence's own remedy (migrate to a knowledge concept, leave a pointer stub) does not apply. Move it: git mv docs/specs/pstack.md docs/history/research/pstack-source.md. Then repoint every citation of the old path — docs/history/research/pstack-distill.md and docs/history/pstack-adoption/CONTEXT.md both name docs/specs/pstack.md.
acceptance: specs_fence passes. No file remains under docs/specs/ that the fence names as new area truth. rg -n 'docs/specs/pstack' over docs/ returns nothing.

truths: cargo test -p bee --test specs_fence passes on the working tree
docs/specs/pstack.md no longer exists; docs/history/research/pstack-source.md does
rg -n 'docs/specs/pstack' over docs/ returns no hits

trace.dropped_reason: Not a feature cell. docs/specs/pstack.md was UNTRACKED in the main checkout only — the worktree at the branch commit never had it, so the red never reached this feature or CI. Fixed as main-checkout housekeeping instead: moved to docs/history/research/pstack-source.md.
